item.title: Dog-Friendly Cremorne — Parks, Cafes and Walks
item.description:
Being a Dog Owner in Cremorne

Melbourne is a dog city, and Cremorne holds its own for four-legged residents. Whether you’ve got a cattle dog that needs actual exercise or a French Bulldog that considers a 10-minute waddle an expedition, this suburb has something for you.

Off-Leash Parks and Spaces

Cremorne has dedicated off-leash areas where your dog can actually run. The local parks have designated off-leash zones (usually with time restrictions — check the signage).

item.title: Dog-Friendly Richmond 2026: Parks, Cafes and Yarra River Walks
item.description:
Melbourne is a dog city, and Richmond holds its own for four-legged residents. Whether you’ve got a cattle dog that needs actual exercise or a French Bulldog that considers a 10-minute waddle an expedition, this suburb has parks, cafes, and river walks that make dog ownership genuinely enjoyable.

Off-Leash Parks and Spaces

Richmond’s off-leash options are managed by the City of Yarra. Check signage at each park for current time restrictions — most operate off-leash before 9am and after 5pm on weekdays, with extended hours on weekends.
